periocular_spatial_geometry.dominant_axis_orientation: The primary axis of the eye patches is oriented at approximately 70 to 80 degrees relative to the horizontal facial axis, tilting inward toward the snout.
periocular_spatial_geometry.aspect_ratio_factor: The patches exhibit an oval geometry with a vertical-to-horizontal aspect ratio of approximately 1.5:1.
periocular_spatial_geometry.inferior_centroid_shift: There is a pronounced downward tapering at the inferior pole, resulting in a centroid located in the upper half of the patch.

dorsal_band_topology.vertex_curvature_index: The posterior edge of the dorsal band displays a wide, shallow U-shape profile across the upper back.
dorsal_band_topology.normalized_band_thickness: The band is thick and prominent, covering roughly 25% of the visible dorsal length from the neck to the mid-torso.

cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.inter_bounding_box_euclidean_distance: The ears are separated by a distinct gap roughly 1.5 times the width of an individual pinna base.
cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.apex_contour_smoothness: The top boundaries of the ears are highly smooth and semicircular with no flattening.
